title: Bell and Hymn
author: Felix Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
